component.name: Argus
component.summary: Modern, fluid video player & streaming companion

description.p: Argus is a sleek, ultra-responsive media player and streaming hub featuring mpv-accelerated playback, smart subtitles auto-synchronization, video queue management, and multi-profile tracking.

ul.li: Video watch queue with drag-to-reorder and continuous play
Harbor Account integration with custom handle and theme sharing
G1NYU community eBook and manga repository integration
Continue Watching play unreleased episodes toggle
End screen recommendations on still-airing series
